intro: Taiwan is a multi-party democracy with a directly elected president.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for four years and appoints the premier. The Legislative Yuan has 113 seats. The two big parties are the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) and the Kuomintang (KMT).
Lai Ching-te of the DPP became president in 2024.

chapters.title: International status
text: Only about a dozen countries formally recognise the Republic of China. Taiwan competes at the Olympics as 'Chinese Taipei'.
